rows.note: This is the all-purpose everyday choice for a chance event or coincidence.

example.english: Finding this old book again was pure happenstance.
example.traditional: 呢次搵返本舊書真係巧合。
example.jyutping: ni1 ci3 wan2 faan2 bun2 gau6 syu1 zan1 hai6 haau2 hap6

rows.note: Use this when discussing the random quality of an event or circumstance itself, rather than a particular coincidence.

example.english: The happenstance of the event makes the research results difficult to reproduce.
example.traditional: 事件本身嘅偶然性，令研究結果難以重現。
example.jyutping: si6 gin2 bun2 san1 ge3 ngau5 jin4 sing3 ling6 jin4 gau3 git3 gwo2 naan4 ji5 cung4 jin6
